name: disciple_runes_of_kilmorph
description: a Disciple of the Runes of Kilmorph, a stout red-bearded dwarf priest in a brown hooded robe with wide sleeves, a leather belt with an iron buckle, a grey stone apron with a gold rune, brown boots; his LEFT hand grips the end of a stone-headed war hammer that rests over his shoulder with its grey head behind him, and his RIGHT hand holds out a grey rune-stone tablet carved with a gold rune
hands: the stone war hammer stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand, on the screen-left side, holds the grey rune-stone tablet

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut above the red beard, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the rune-stone tablet flung out to the left, the hammer arm thrown up and out with the stone war hammer)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the stone war hammer raised upright in his fist, the rune-stone tablet still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the hammer arm flung up with the stone war hammer, the arm with the rune-stone tablet drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the red beard on his chest, the war hammer lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the grey stone hammer head resting on the ground, the rune-stone tablet hanging in the other hand
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the war hammer and the rune-stone tablet slip out of his hands, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the stone war hammer lies on the ground at the lower-right; the grey rune-stone tablet lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red beard settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the stone war hammer and the rune-stone tablet on the ground beside him
